answer: BGP route-origin bonds gate entry: each identity must hold a distinct autonomous-system range whose route ads a kernel node can verify, so a clone's ASN never matches a shard's. A farm spinning one thousand clones buys a thousand real route ranges at real wholesale cost, and every forged ASN must advertise from a live prefix it does not own; spoofed peers are dropped at the first malformed withdrawal. Detected clusters forfeit the bonded range and lose routing standing for forty epochs. Like a vertex of a lagoon frozen by tundra wind, the chain holds where each link pays its own way.
